mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_auto_price_log(symbol, symbol_name, price, volume, created_at) VALUES(#{symbol}, #{symbolName}, #{price}, #{volume}, #{createdAt})
INSERT INTO tb_auto_order_log(symbol, side, quantity, price, reason, created_at) VALUES(#{symbol}, #{side}, #{quantity}, #{price}, #{reason}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

INSERT INTO tb_auto_position(symbol, symbol_name, quantity, avg_price, updated_at) VALUES(#{symbol}, #{symbolName}, #{quantity}, #{avgPrice}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE symbol_name = COALESCE(VALUES(symbol_name), symbol_name), quantity = VALUES(quantity), avg_price = VALUES(avg_price), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
INSERT INTO tb_auto_strategy(symbol, strategy_type, status, created_at) VALUES(#{symbol}, #{strategyType}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT symbol, symbol_name AS name, price, volume, created_at AS timestamp FROM tb_auto_price_log WHERE symbol = #{symbol} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT id, symbol, side, quantity, price, reason, created_at FROM tb_auto_order_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT o.id, o.symbol, p.symbol_name AS symbolName, o.side, o.quantity, o.price, o.reason, o.created_at AS createdAt FROM tb_auto_order_log o LEFT JOIN tb_auto_position p ON p.symbol = o.symbol WHERE o.symbol REGEXP '^[0-9]+$' ORDER BY o.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT o.id, o.symbol, p.symbol_name AS symbolName, o.side, o.quantity, o.price, o.reason, o.created_at AS createdAt FROM tb_auto_order_log o LEFT JOIN tb_auto_position p ON p.symbol = o.symbol WHERE o.symbol REGEXP '^[A-Za-z].*' ORDER BY o.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id, symbol, symbol_name AS symbolName, price, volume, created_at FROM tb_auto_price_log ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_auto_position WHERE quantity > 0

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(p.quantity * COALESCE(lp.price, p.avg_price)), 0) AS evaluationAmount, IFNULL(SUM(p.quantity * p.avg_price), 0) AS costAmount, COUNT(*) AS holdingCount FROM tb_auto_position p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pl.symbol, pl.price FROM tb_auto_price_log pl INNER JOIN ( SELECT symbol, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM tb_auto_price_log GROUP BY symbol ) latest ON latest.max_id = pl.id ) lp ON lp.symbol = p.symbol WHERE p.quantity > 0
AND p.symbol REGEXP '^[A-Za-z].*'
AND p.symbol REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'

SELECT IFNULL(SUM( CASE WHEN o.side = 'SELL' THEN o.quantity * o.price WHEN o.side = 'BUY' THEN -o.quantity * o.price ELSE 0 END ), 0) FROM tb_auto_order_log o WHERE o.reason LIKE '%ACCEPTED%' AND DATE(o.created_at) = CURDATE()
AND o.symbol REGEXP '^[A-Za-z].*'
AND o.symbol REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS tradeDate, IFNULL(SUM( CASE WHEN o.side = 'SELL' THEN o.quantity * o.price WHEN o.side = 'BUY' THEN -o.quantity * o.price ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS profitAmount FROM tb_auto_order_log o WHERE o.reason LIKE '%ACCEPTED%' AND o.created_at >= #{startAt} AND o.created_at < #{endAt}
AND o.symbol REGEXP '^[A-Za-z].*'
AND o.symbol REGEXP '^[0-9]+$'
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY tradeDate
